tools.name: plan-branch-guard
tools.description: PreToolUse: block phase plan commits referencing branches already merged into main

tools.name: defer-forever-guard
tools.description: PreToolUse: block Deferred Items / Backlog table rows missing Owner or YYYY-MM-DD Due date

tools.name: engines-node-guard
tools.description: PreToolUse: block npm/pnpm/yarn install in Node projects with no .nvmrc and no engines.node pin

tools.name: manifest-completeness-guard
tools.description: PreToolUse: block claude-env commits adding hooks/helpers not declared in tooling-manifest.json

tools.name: phase-preflight
tools.description: Validates a phase plan's fenced ```prerequisites YAML block: branch state, env vars, binaries, playwright install, pre-push hook presence

tools.name: phase-pr-check
tools.description: Pre-PR readiness: every 'Phase N Done When' checkbox is [x], branch is not main, PR body references the phase file

tools.name: validate-ac-coverage
tools.description: Validates AC references in phase plans against test-requirements.md; surfaces browser-matrix conflicts

tools.name: phase-md-template
tools.description: Canonical phase plan template with mandatory Pre-Phase Sync, Environmental Prerequisites YAML block, Done When, and dated Deferred Items table

tools.name: cf-deploy-preflight
tools.description: Generic Cloudflare deploy preflight: catches shell-exported framework env vars (PUBLIC_*, NEXT_PUBLIC_*) and leftover ephemeral fixtures in public/ that would ship to production. Parameterized via --public-prefix and --fixture flags

tools.name: endpoints-schema
tools.description: Canonical JSON Schema for the endpoint registry pattern; companion projects copy or reference this instead of duplicating per-repo

tools.name: nvmrc-template
tools.description: Default Node version pin (20) for new projects; pair with the engines_node_guard.py hook

tools.name: windows-service-build-release
tools.description: Reusable GitHub Actions workflow (workflow_call) for building and releasing a self-contained .NET Windows service. Inputs: app_name, project_path, appsettings_source, dotnet_version, publish_dir. Replaces the byte-identical (mod env) build-release.yml duplicated in whisper-service and SysTTS

tools.name: azure-deploy-preflight
tools.description: Reusable GitHub Actions workflow (workflow_call) for the Azure-deploy confirmation + RG access verification preflight. Inputs: resource_group, confirm_deploy, reason. Secret: azure_credentials. Centralizes the duplicated preflight job in stock-analyzer and road-trip

tools.name: bicep-key-vault
tools.description: Reusable Bicep module: Standard-SKU Key Vault with RBAC auth, soft-delete, optional purge protection. Parameterizes retention days and tags

tools.name: bicep-key-vault-role-assignment
tools.description: Reusable Bicep module: scoped RBAC role-assignment on a Key Vault. Idempotent (deterministic guid name). Pairs with bicep-key-vault for cross-RG access patterns

tools.name: publish-bicep-modules-workflow
tools.description: GitHub Actions workflow that publishes Bicep modules under infrastructure/bicep/modules/ to the shared ACR registry. Tag-triggered (bicep/vX.Y.Z), OIDC authenticated, environment-gated

tools.name: bicep-registry-setup-runbook
tools.description: One-time setup runbook for the Bicep publishing pipeline: Azure SP creation, AcrPush role, federated identity credential, GitHub environment, and release procedure

tools.name: sync-claude-md
tools.description: Assembles a repo's CLAUDE.md from shared claude-env/shared/claude-md/ fragments + the repo's CLAUDE.local.md; --check mode detects drift
